detail.title: Foundations of Autonomous Objective Discovery in Artificial Systems
detail.summary: Autonomous systems can generate objectives through intrinsic motivation, such as curiosity-driven exploration, combined with multi-agent evolutionary frameworks that enable persistent, self-directed search. These mechanisms allow agents to progress in environments lacking explicit reward structures, though the long-term stability of these objectives requires further longitudinal validation.
detail.reason: The project is synthesis-ready and requires a provisional notebook to consolidate collected research on autonomous objective formulation.
